text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's October. Taiki Shuttle goes wild<n>along with the
crowd as the top<n>Umamusume on the scene sprints
full<n>speed ahead.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Otherworldly Front-Runner,<n>Silence Suzuka,
takes the glory with<n>her daring runaway style!

Fully captivated by her performance,<n>a swarm of
fans gather near the<n>winner's circle to celebrate
her<n>victory.
